question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Abundance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abundance"** means a very large quantity of something. (प्रचुरता)

 
 
• **Example: **There was an** abundance **of food at the festival, enough to feed everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Scanty" **refers to something that is insufficient in quantity or amount; not enough. (अल्प)
 
 
• **Example: **The rainfall this year has been **scanty,** leading to concerns about water shortages.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Abundance' **is **'Scanty'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Endemic** (स्थानिक): Regularly found among particular people or in a certain area.

 
 
• **Example:** Malaria is endemic in many tropical regions.
 
 
 
• **Deluge** (प्रलय): A severe flood or an overwhelming amount of something.
 
 
• **Example: **After the drought, the region experienced a deluge that caused widespread damage.
 
 
 
• **Epidemic** (महामारी): A widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time.
 
 
• **Example:** The flu epidemic of 1918 had devastating effects worldwide.
